items.summary_html:
Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

[2.3.2] - 2026-09-08 🚀 Features
  • (tests) 🧪 create testing.sh for managing Ludus test VMs
  • (tests) 🧪 update testing.sh to use API tokens. Update developer docs to match.
🐛 Bug Fixes
  • (server) 🐛 fix sysprep to handle multiple concurrent windows syspreps and be more robust
  • (client) 🐛 correctly apply verify setting
⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks
  • 🤖 remove existing Proxmox collection before installation to allow CI retries
  • Update Debian 13 router seeds
  • Bound blocked network checks
